teams.blurb: Top of both halves of the formula: Win-Now #1 and Dynasty #2. The 18-3-1 record comes with the #1 points total and a 77-21 all-play mark; the rest-of-season projection ranks #1, the best in the league. Jahmyr Gibbs, Malik Nabers and Matthew Golden lead the roster value; it's one of the two youngest cores in the league by value.

The roster carries this ranking: Dynasty #1, built on Ja'Marr Chase, Brock Bowers and Jordan Love, outweighs a Win-Now rank of only #5. The 10-12 record comes with the #2 points total and a 55-44 all-play mark, so the record undersells the team; the rest-of-season projection ranks #6. Jeremiyah Love and Davante Adams are out or on IR, which drags the projection.

Win-Now #3 and Dynasty #4 land this team right about here. The 14-8 record comes with the #8 points total and a 43-56 all-play mark, so the record flatters it; the rest-of-season projection ranks #2. Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Caleb Williams and Kenneth Walker III lead the roster value. The Week 11 trade for Sam LaPorta, 2027 R2 (Brian's) and 2028 R2 (Drew's) is already priced in.

The roster carries this ranking: Dynasty #3, built on Josh Allen, CeeDee Lamb and Trey McBride, outweighs a Win-Now rank of only #6. The 11-10-1 record comes with the #3 points total and a 58-40 all-play mark, so the record undersells the team; the rest-of-season projection ranks #9, near the bottom.

Bijan Robinson, Joe Burrow and Trevor Lawrence lead the roster value; only 3 future picks left after trading some away holds down the dynasty side. Michael Pittman Jr. is out or on IR, which drags the projection.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, Tee Higgins and De'Von Achane lead the roster value; it's one of the two oldest cores in the league by value. De'Von Achane is out or on IR, which drags the projection.

Jayden Daniels, Fernando Mendoza and Isaiah Likely lead the roster value. The Week 11 trade for Rome Odunze is already priced in.

Dynasty #6, built on Brock Purdy, Justin Jefferson and Ashton Jeanty, is the only thing keeping this team out of the basement; Win-Now ranks #9. The 4-18 record comes with the #9 points total and a 26-73 all-play mark, so the record is earned; the rest-of-season projection ranks #8. 12 different defenses this season is the league high, and none of that is one of the inputs; Jaxson Dart and Michael Wilson are out or on IR, which drags the projection.
